summary: Gold Fields Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine director share purchase. A non-executive director, JF MacKenzie, acquired 500 ordinary shares on the open market at R549.97 per share for a total of R274,985.00. The transaction was cleared under JSE Listings Requirements. This is a routine share dealing disclosure by a director, not a special situation event. No special situation event occurs; it is a standard reporting of insider trading that requires no further action or risk-arb analysis.
